description: Fill a template with words. The service draws each page in the saved brand’s colours and fonts, saves it as a picture and answers the media ids, in page order, ready to attach to a draft. Look at each one with media_view before the user sees it. A photo on a page is one the user already uploaded (its media id from media_list) or an https address.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

cut.description: The shape of the pictures, one per network: portrait (1080 by 1350) for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Threads; landscape (1600 by 900) for X and Bluesky; pin (1080 by 1620) for Pinterest. templates_list says which cuts each template has. The template’s own shape when left out.

language.description: The language of the words the service prints itself, such as the days of the week and "Closed": English (en), Spanish (es), Portuguese (pt), French (fr) or Haitian Creole (ht). English when left out.

pages.description: The pages in order, as many as the template takes. A carousel ends on an action page.

type.description: Required. The page type, one of the template’s own (templates_get lists them). The page’s other fields are that type’s fields, each within its limit of characters and lines.

series.description: A short series name shown on the pages, where the template has one.

name: templates_render
title: Make a designed post
